scope: Fixed 60 synthetic documents and 248 train/calibration queries; no check or acceptance-v6 fitting, execution or selection.

model.language: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean per model card
model.source: Official original checkpoint; repository has no ONNX. ONNX export and Q8 quantization are local research conversions with pinned tools and artifacts, not official model files.

score.probabilityInterpretation: model relevance score, not calibrated correctness or answerability probability
score.referenceCaveat: Maintainer reports 0.35/0.4 in own use as context-dependent references, not universal gates.

pairs: Same authenticated original 96 UTF-16 character window with overlap16; union of raw top5 each BGE-small-zh and existing multilingual MiniLM L12 plus all current 90a weak lexical fields; deduplicate exact query+original field/span; retain ranks and roles.
producer: TopK 1/3/4/5 before strong exemption, no refill; coarseMinimum multilingual MiniLM null/0.34 and BGE-small-zh null/0.48 only as inherited per-model comparators, no assumed common calibration. Weak lexical work independent of coarse threshold.
tokenizer: official pinned query/document pair template, physical batch1, joint limit512 including special tokens; no truncation, over-budget unknown/partial. Verify JS against separate official tokenizer.json implementation.
metrics: Full-language gate, reported separately from Chinese-only descriptive axis: both train/cal zh-zh R@5>=.90, zh-en/en-zh R@5>=.85, MRR>=.75, pure OOD FPR<=.05, entity mismatch FPR<=.05 and exact ID preservation; full denominator, unknown not true negative; report en-en and missing-field/number separately.
numerics: Compare local FP32/Q8 on a fixed stratified sample, raw logits and sigmoid scores, ranking and source-checkpoint reference. No assumption of parity; keep paired inputs and token IDs.
resources: Sequential sole-model processes, actual process exit, cold and warm single-pair timing, graph/model/tokenizer bytes and peak process RSS; separate simultaneous coarse+verifier measurement required for total.
limits: Development comparison only; no production default, package, acceptance threshold, or model manifest edits; no check or v6. No automatic memory authority.
